description:
A newly refurbished one-bedroom apartment within the popular Park West development, moments from Hyde Park and benefiting from 24-hour porterage.  The property is available immediately and is offered unfurnished. 

The apartment has been refurbished throughout and offers well-proportioned, bright accommodation comprising a spacious lounge/dining room, separate contemporary kitchen, double bedroom with built-in storage, and a modern shower room.

Park West is a well-established purpose-built development with the benefit of 24-hour porterage, ideally positioned for the shops, restaurants and amenities of Connaught Village, Marylebone and the West End. The open spaces of Hyde Park are also just a short walk away.

The property is particularly well connected, with Marble Arch, Edgware Road and Paddington stations all within easy reach, providing Underground, National Rail, Elizabeth line and Heathrow Express services.
